We offer a number of flexible working arrangements that suit those who prefer to work in an Assessment Centre full time or in a hybrid role.

• Carrying out functional assessments with claimants’ face to face, via video & telephone to assess their ability to undertake activities of daily living.
• Asking focused questions and use active listening and critical reasoning skills to gather accurate information throughout the claimant Assessment.
• Produce high quality, structured clinical reports on all claimants you assess, for submission to the DWP.
• Working alongside other highly experienced clinical colleagues to ensure high-quality & clinically fair assessments for all claimants.

• Predictable hours
• Up to 10% quarterly discretionary bonus

• Private pension
• Private medical insurance

• Paid, structured training to achieve formal DWP accreditation
• A high performing, supportive clinically led culture
• Clear career routes within Ingeus and the wider APM Group
• Online shopping discounts
• Variety of other financial and lifestyle options
• £2000 refer a friend scheme
Whilst you will not be making decisions or recommendations as to the services and benefits for claimants, you will be using your clinical experience to ask the right questions to fully understand the claimants needs and living environment, gathering accurate information for the DWP to make those decisions.

Many clinicians find the role of a Functional Assessor rewarding, but it’s also challenging at the same time and it’s not the right fit for everyone.
This role would suit someone who:
• Thrives on service excellence in a high performing working environment that offers structure and the opportunity to use your clinical skills in a different way.
• Is open to a formalised programme of training to become a DWP approved Functional Assessor.
• Is receptive to ongoing constructive feedback, ensuring our claimants continually get the very best experience.
• Has confidence in their ability to use computers and in learning different software packages to complete detailed, high-quality reports for all claimants assessed.

• You are not comfortable using or are unfamiliar with technology.

Our practice has a fantastic team of clinicians and support colleagues providing high quality general dentistry to a loyal, long established patient base both private and NHS.

• We are proud of our consistently high NPS scores
• A busy practice with high local demand
• Excellent opportunity to take on a Clinical Lead role within the practice
About the Principal Dentist / PCL Opportunity
Our vision for each practice is for it to be led in partnership by two critical roles:
• A high performing Practice Manager (PM) who focuses on financial, operational and people leadership and
• A Practice Clinical Lead (PCL) who focuses on the clinical leadership of the practice, how clinical factors directly impact the performance and direction of the practice and who works with the Practice Manager.
We recently introduced the Practice Clinical Lead role into a number of our practices, to help us emulate the leadership that is lost when former practice owners either leave their practices or look to focus on wider interests. We’ve seen some impressive results from our first 35 PCLs, many of whom feel they have embarked on a whole new dentistry adventure through this opportunity. Consequently, we are now recruiting new Practice Clinical Leads to help us achieve this same success across more of our practices.
The Practice Manager and Practice Clinical Lead work together as the practice leadership team to lead the practice and make it as efficient and successful as possible, while being a great place for colleagues to work and clinicians to practice and deliver high levels of clinical care.
This really is a unique opportunity to gain exposure to the commercial and leadership aspects of an ambitious and high growth business, in an environment that will provide you with the support and development you need in order to achieve your potential.
Your key, high-level responsibilities as PCL will be to:
• Act as a clinical leadership figure in the practice alongside the Practice Manager, with the ability to influence the direction of the practice.
• Provide clinical focus and maintaining clinical standards.
• With our support, define the practice ambition and strategy.
• Mentor others and give them a clinical voice.
• Act as a cultural ambassador for the Portman Group as well as the practice.
• Provide a positive influence to all practice colleagues to support engagement.
About You
We’d love to hear from you if you…
• Are a practising clinician with broad clinical experience, looking for an additional challenge and adventure in dentistry.
• Have a keen interest in the commercial and leadership side of dentistry and want to learn more in a supportive environment.
• Are excited by and want to positively influence and provide leadership.
• Are looking to further develop your career.
• Are a good relationship builder and collaborator, with a rational and balanced approach.
• Have the ability to navigate relationships and gain the respect of peers.
• Are credible, respected and hold yourself to high ethical standards.
What’s in it for you:
• An opportunity to gain exposure to the commercial and leadership aspects of dentistry with support and development to help you realise your potential.
• Experience of working for a small part of your week in a employed role for a leading dental provider.  This role will be distinct and separate from any Associate Dentist Agreement.
• A guaranteed monthly salary for the duties carried out as Practice Clinical Lead.
• And be rewarded with a share of the practice profit with no personal investment required.

The Role:
The Building Services Shift Manager is responsible for leading a hands on shift operation to ensure the warehouse remains safe, compliant, fully operational, and well maintained. This role involves prioritising workloads, allocating tasks, and providing di rect support to engineers and technicians. The postholder will respond to breakdowns and urgent facilities issues, ensuring timely resolution and effective communication across both Operations and Facilities teams. Acting as the first point of escalation for all facilities related technical issues during shift, the Building Services Shift Manager will ensure repairs are completed to the required standard, risks are appropriately managed, and any significant concerns the Site Facilities Manager and Building Services Manager.
Responsibilities:
• Lead and supervise a team of Engineers and Support Technicians on shift.
• Plan, prepare and lead engineering projects and works, providing technical input where required.
• Manage team attendance, absence and overall shift performance.
• Develop and manage team rotas in collaboration with other Shift Managers.
• Allocate and prioritise daily workloads, including reactive tasks, planned maintenance, and operational support.
• Ensure the team clearly understands shift priorities, safety expectations, and required standards of work.
• Act as the first escalation point for all facilities and maintenance issues during shift.
• Provide coaching, guidance, and ongoing support to Engineers and Technicians.
• Conduct and document regular 1:1 meetings with team members.
• Support the scheduling and assignment of work across the team.
• Carry out engineering duties across electrical, mechanical, and building services (MEP).
• Coordinate response to breakdowns, defects, and site issues, including equipment faults, leaks, lighting, doors, welfare facilities, and yard maintenance.
• Ensure all temporary repairs, make safe actions, and permanent fixes are completed effectively and to standard.
• Escalate major faults, recurring issues, or high risk concerns to the Building Services Manager
• Maintain accurate records of all job updates within relevant systems and shift handover logs.
• Administer and utilise departmental systems and software effectively.
• Support and develop the team to operate efficiently within a fast paced - retail warehouse environment.
• Maintain strong working relationships through effective communication and a professional, collaborative approach.
• Support the wider Facilities team and contribute to overall departmental objectives.
• Carry out quality checks and spot inspections of completed work.
• Identify and implement opportunities for improved ways of working.
• Monitor contractor activity, ensuring work is completed safely, to scope, and with minimal disruption.
• Communicate contractor activities to Operations where impacts may occur.
• Escalate contractor performance issues, delays, or safety concerns to the Site Facilities Manager.
• Provide cover for the Building Services Manager when required.
• Promote team wellbeing and seek additional support where necessary.

• Significant experience within a warehouse or large scale site environment, managing both planned and reactive maintenance.
• Strong background in electrical or mechanical engineering (typically 10+ years).
• Relevant technical qualification (e.g. Level 3 NVQ, City & Guilds, HNC/HND in Electrical, Mechanical or Plumbing).
• Up to date electrical knowledge, including 18th Edition (preferred).
• Working knowledge of health and safety legislation (IOSH/NEBOSH or equivalent).
• Proven experience in maintenance operations, including contractor management, fault escalation, shift planning, and operational communication.
• Experience managing asset lifecycle, including refurbishment and replacement of end - of -life equipment.
• Strong knowledge of building services and equipment such as MHE, conveyors, dock doors, HVAC, lighting, plumbing, fire systems, and BMS.
• Experience using CAFM systems, BMS, and Microsoft Office 365.
• Demonstrated ability to lead and manage teams in a fast paced environment including administration responsibilities.
• Ability to communicate technical information clearly to non technical stakeholders.
• Flexible approach to working patterns, including overtime and on- call rota cover where required.
• Proactive. adaptable, and solution focused, with the ability to work under pressure and respond to changing prorities.
• Self motivated and resilient, with the ability to sustain high performance over extended periods.

About This Job
We are looking for a Commercial Sales Lead to help us find new customers, build valuable partnerships and create commercial opportunities across the business.
Reporting directly to the General Manager, this is a hands-on role for someone who combines a natural flair for sales with commercial creativity, energy and initiative.
We’re not looking for a conventional hotel revenue manager whose focus is primarily on managing rates and occupancy. We’re looking for a commercial hunter — someone who enjoys being out in the market, opening doors, building relationships and turning ideas into revenue.
You’ll have the freedom to identify opportunities and the responsibility to pursue them.
Key Responsibilities
Outbound Business Development
• Own the proactive sales effort across our hotels and wider commercial proposition.
• Identify new customer segments, markets and sources of business.
• Develop and execute targeted outbound sales campaigns.
• Build a strong pipeline of corporate, leisure, group, event and partnership opportunities.
• Develop relationships with businesses, travel companies, agents, event planners and other potential commercial partners.
• Take opportunities from initial conversation through to conversion.
• Be persistent and creative in finding ways to win business.
Network & Partnership Building
• Build and maintain a high-quality network of contacts across Cornwall, the South West and relevant national markets.
• Identify brands, businesses, creators and organisations that could introduce us to new audiences.
• Develop mutually beneficial commercial partnerships.
• Represent the hotels at relevant networking events, trade events and industry opportunities.
• Look beyond traditional hotel channels to find new routes to market.
New customer development
• Identify audiences and markets we are currently under-serving.
• Develop propositions and campaigns designed specifically to reach them.
• Combine direct sales, partnerships, PR, social media and creative marketing to generate demand.
• Bring ideas to the business about new products, packages, experiences and reasons to visit.
• Monitor market trends and competitor activity and look for opportunities to do things differently.
Event & Function Sales
• Drive new business across weddings, private events, corporate events, celebrations and group bookings.
• Develop relationships with event organisers, local businesses and relevant agencies.
• Proactively sell our spaces, restaurants, accommodation and experiences.
• Create new event propositions and commercial opportunities where there is untapped demand.
Marketing, PR & Social Media
• Take a leading role in the commercial side of our marketing, PR and social media activity.
• Develop campaigns and content that generate awareness, engagement and ultimately bookings.
• Help shape how both hotels are positioned and presented to the market.
• Build relationships with media, influencers and relevant creators.
• Find imaginative and cost-effective ways to get the hotels in front of new audiences.
• Bring personality, style and creativity to everything we put into the market.
Commercial Performance
• Set clear commercial objectives and track the results of activity.
• Understand the economics behind different opportunities and prioritise those with the greatest potential.
• Use data to inform decisions without becoming constrained by it.
• Work closely with the General Manager and hotel teams to turn commercial opportunities into profitable business.
• Identify opportunities to increase spend and value across rooms, F&B, spa, events and experiences.

Qualifications
We’re less interested in finding someone who ticks every box than someone who has the right commercial instinct and attitude.
You might come from hospitality, travel, events, lifestyle, premium retail, media, marketing or another highly commercial environment. You may not have followed a conventional hotel career path — and that's absolutely fine.
What matters is that you can demonstrate that you create opportunities, win business and make things happen.
We’re looking for someone who is:
• Sales hungry — you genuinely enjoy winning business and are motivated by results.
• A natural relationship builder — you can open doors, build trust and turn contacts into opportunities.
• Creative — you see possibilities others might miss and can turn an idea into something commercially useful.
• Energetic — you bring pace and enthusiasm and don't wait to be told what to do.
• Self-motivated — once you understand the objective, you get on with finding a way to achieve it.
• Commercially sharp — you understand targets, margins, return on investment and what makes an idea commercially worthwhile.
• Confident and personable — you're comfortable representing the hotels and talking to everyone from local business owners to senior decision-makers.
• Curious and entrepreneurial — you're always looking for the next opportunity.
• Stylish and brand-aware — you understand that how we present ourselves matters.

This role is to lead our HTS magnet technology development programme to realise STEP’s HTS magnet system. Principal Stress Engineer / Technical Lead
📍Location: Newcastle, Derby, Bristol, Bolton, London, Glasgow, Warrington
🚀 Join the Fusion and Modular Nuclear Business Unit! 🚀 Assystem’s Fusion and Modular Nuclear team are working on some of the most projects in the UK. Our Simulation and Assessment team of stress engineers support these projects by producing design and regulatory justification assessments of high-integrity and safety critical components to international codes and standard such as RCC-M or ASME III.
We are seeking a Principal Stress Engineer role who will lead the scoping, bidding and delivery of stress engineering work packages, and building and leading a team to deliver this work.
• Lead bids and projects
• Develop future technical leaders
• Plan capability, resourcing and business wining alongside our leadership team
Your Mission:
1. Technical Delivery
You will lead project teams and technical work in client facing roles, delivering high-quality stress analysis and structural integrity assessments:
• Act as a technical lead for stress and structural integrity, providing expert advice, troubleshooting, and technical oversight.
• Represent Assystem in client meetings.
• Serve as an Independent Technical Approver to ensure the highest engineering standards.
• Use Finite Element Analysis and traditional hand calculations to justify strength, fatigue, defect tolerance, and structural performance to international codes and standards (including pressure vessel and defect-tolerance codes).
• Collaborate closely with safety case authors, design engineers, and multidisciplinary delivery teams.
• Mentor junior engineers, offering technical guidance and helping shape our next generation of stress specialists.
2. Capability Development
Your role will play an important part in developing and growing Assystem’s internal stress capability:
Capability Development
• Support the strategic development roadmap for the UK stress engineering capability.
• Maintain and improve technical processes, methods, best-practice guides and quality frameworks.
• Monitor workload, skill gaps and training needs across the stress discipline.
• Lead technical upskilling initiatives such as internal training pathways.
Team Growth, Recruitment & Retention
• Work with the Engineering Directors and Business Management teams to forecast demand, plan workforce requirements, and shape the long-term capability pipeline.
• Support recruitment campaigns, interviewing and selecting high-quality candidates.
• Ensure strong retention by fostering a supportive culture, mentoring talent, and providing growth opportunities.
Bidding & Business Development
• Collaborate with Sales and Business Development teams to identify opportunities where stress capability adds value.
• Lead bids, proposals, client presentations and technical sales materials.
• Represent stress capability in major pursuits and innovation initiatives.
Internal & External Leadership
• Act as a visible leader and ambassador for stress engineering across Assystem and with clients.
• Build and maintain relationships with key technical stakeholders, partners and industry bodies.

• 🏠 Hybrid work: 1-2 days remote per week.

Qualifications

• Lead high-performing teams supporting a range of customers and industry sectors.
• Lead stress and structural integrity assessment projects using modern techniques.
• Deliver and review high-quality technical assessments to recognised standards.
• Mentor and guide junior engineers while acting as a senior technical reference point.
• Work directly with clients to tackle complex stress and integrity challenges.
• Demonstrate expert FE analysis capability (strength, fatigue, defects, lifetime assessments).
• Apply ASME III / ASME VIII, RCC-M, R6 codes.
• Desirable: experience in CFD, dynamics, fatigue, and degradation mechanisms.
• Must have experience in the nuclear sector or a comparable highly regulated sector.
Your Toolbox Should Include…
• Degree in engineering + Chartered Engineer (CEng).
• Experience in stress assessments in the nuclear sector.
• Strong communicator with excellent commercial awareness.
• Expert in ABAQUS (or ANSYS, LS-Dyna, etc.).
• Experience with Altair Hyperworks or similar tools.

About This Job
Senior/Principal EIA Consultant
Southampton, Bristol, Corsham, Birmingham and Lewes, United Kingdom
Do you want to push the boundaries of your profession and develop your excellence in an open, collaborative and empowering culture? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature? Are you our new Senior or Principal EIA Consultant?
If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Impact Assessment department and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.
Your new role
You will bring your knowledge of Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) and Environmental Management into play as you co-ordinate statutory EIA, non-statutory environmental assessment and environmental due diligence processes required to support major development proposals across a range of sectors.  You will have the opportunity to drive sustainable change through all stages in the project lifecycle across the data centre, industrial and property sectors. To succeed in this role, you will be able to work in a multi-disciplinary environment and apply an understanding of environmental consenting processes in the UK as well as an understanding of EIA process and regulations and will have the opportunity to support projects at various stages in the project lifecycle from early stage due diligence, feasibility, masterplanning and through EIA, to consent condition compliance.
Your key responsibilities will be:
• Project management and coordination of environmental baseline data collection, interpretation of data and collaboration with colleagues and co-professionals to advise clients on environmental and sustainability constraints and opportunities for development.
• Report writing (including due diligence, EIA screening & scoping reports, Environmental Statements, and other environmental reports), review of reporting and coordination of management of spatial data including for the preparation of figures.
• Coordination and management of key technical and commercial aspects of project delivery.
• Contributing to Impact Assessment business development activities, including the preparation of fee proposals, tender submissions, marketing materials and presentations.
• Support the team’s leadership and wider management with team functions, including mentoring junior members of the team.
• Developing relationships with both Ramboll colleagues, supply chain partners and our clients.
• Engagement and liaison with clients at meetings and networking events.
Your new team
You will be part of our UK Impact Assessment department, which forms part of our Global Impact Assessment Service Line. The Service Line has been established to drive further growth and specialisation in Impact Assessment, building on our existing successes through a continued focus on national impact assessment work, alongside targeting large, strategic projects – no matter where these occur, within our geographic strongholds or beyond.  Our UK business employs over 300 environmental science professionals in 19 locations and covers a breadth of consulting services structured around impact assessment, compliance, strategy and transactions, new initiatives and sustainability, product safety and stewardship, contaminated land, and water. Our clients include UK and global multinationals, utilities, local and central government and international institutions. Ramboll operates a flexible working policy, and with this you will be part of an exciting team of experts, who respect each other and work towards a common goal.

These include:
• Relevant degree in environmental sciences, environmental engineering or a related environmental discipline
• Master’s degree in an environmental discipline (advantageous)
• Relevant project delivery experience
• Strong communication skills both written and oral, with the ability to liaise with colleagues and clients
• A keenness for professional development and progression
What we can offer you
• Strong company commitment and ethos centred on sustainable development, including in the data centre, industrial and property sectors
• Investment in your development
• Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles
• 27 days annual leave plus bank holidays

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. At Ramboll, our core strength is our people, and our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act. Being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. We embrace an inclusive mindset that looks for fresh, diverse, and innovative perspectives. We respect, embrace, and invite diversity in all forms to actively cultivate an environment where everyone can flourish and realise their full potential.
Ready to join us?

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.
Ramboll in the United Kingdom
Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation-owned people company. Our team builds the real-time infrastructure that powers Wise's FX pricing, risk management, and trade execution. We aggregate market data from Bloomberg and Reuters, compute live exposure and VaR, execute hedges worth tens to hundreds of millions of pounds daily, and protect the business from adverse currency movements. Our systems are tier- 1 and serve 50+ internal consumers with sub-second freshness across 50+ currency pairs.
You will be the technical anchor across both engineering teams, owning the architectural direction of 14+ production services, from rate ingestion and distribution, through real-time risk calculation, to automated hedge execution. The primary mission: build Wise's first semi-automated trade and hedge execution platform in close coordination with FX dealers, quantitative researchers, and treasury controllers.

We're looking for people who can step back and think holistically about the ecosystem, but also follow through and help implement the design; drawing on the resources across the rest of the Finance & Treasury tribe.

Architecting a semi-automated hedge execution platform,  from exposure decomposition through model-driven hedge proposals to programmatic trade execution on external partners

Building real-time streaming pipelines with Apache Flink for portfolio-split exposure computation, tenor interpolation, and hedge lifecycle event processing

Evolving our rate infrastructure for 10x throughput with FX Forwards, new corridors, NDFs and work on cross-provider deviation alerting

Building production infrastructure for quant models for VaR, beta-adjusted exposure management, dynamic pricing and FRP cancellations.

Owning Kafka topology design and schema evolution across the full pipeline: rate ingestion → risk calculation → trade execution → analytics

Driving technical roadmap across both teams, mentoring IC2/IC3 engineers, and leading incident response for Tier-1 critical services

8+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally in financial systems, trading, or real-time data infrastructure

Deep expertise in Java (17+) with Spring Boot in high-throughput production environments

Extensive experience with Apache Kafka, topic design, schema evolution, consumer group management at scale

Strong data engineering skills, building real-time streaming pipelines with Apache Flink, Kafka Streams, or equivalent

Proven track record designing and operating distributed systems processing millions of events per day

Demonstrated ability to own system reliability end-to-end: SLOs, alerting, incident response, disaster recovery

Experience leading technical design of complex multi-service architectures and influencing without direct authority

Exceptional product mindset — able to translate business requirements from traders, operations, and quants into technical strategy

Track record of mentoring senior and junior engineers and raising team-wide engineering standards

Pricing is one of the most important ways we stay competitive and grow profitably. In this role you'll help make sure our prices are well structured, competitive in each market and backed by solid data. You'll use market intelligence, analysis and close work with the Tech, Trading and Retail teams to turn insight into price actions. Along the way you'll learn how price investment drives customer and commercial results. This role suits someone analytical and commercially curious who enjoys working with others and wants to build a career in pricing at a leading global fashion retailer.

• Base price architecture: Reviewing base price architecture across our global markets and suggesting changes so prices stay consistent and competitive, and work commercially in each territory.

• Market intelligence: Working with our third-party market intelligence tool and its team, and sharing findings and competitor insights with the wider company.
• Return on investment: Learning how pricing decisions deliver return on investment, and helping measure and explain the results of pricing activity.
• Price change execution: Helping the Pricing Admin run the price change process from start to finish, and working with the Tech teams to find and set up opportunities for process automation.
• Sharing insight: Helping the Pricing Manager share analysis and recommendations from pricing initiatives with the wider Pricing team and key internal stakeholders.
• Elasticity and dynamic pricing: Learning which pricing levers affect elasticity by territory and product type, and using that knowledge to recommend dynamic pricing strategies.
• Reporting: Helping create and send out consolidated weekly and monthly reports on price trading initiatives. These reports track key customer and business metrics and are shared with the wider business.
• Team development: Being an active member of the wider Pricing team and helping develop the Pricing Admins by sharing knowledge, coaching and supporting their growth.

About This Job
At IFS, we’re building the next generation of AI-native enterprise software. We’re looking for a Principal Platform Engineer to build the shared authentication and authorisation capabilities that our product engineering teams depend on.
You should be a hands-on platform engineer who builds through code and automates by default. Your experience might centre on infrastructure as code, deployment pipelines, automation, platform tooling or service integrations. What matters is that you have built reliable, repeatable capabilities that engineering teams use to deliver and operate software.
Your background may be in platform engineering, infrastructure, SRE, identity engineering or systems integration. What matters is substantial hands-on experience building or extending platform capabilities through code and automation, supporting the delivery and operation of software.
A software development background is particularly valuable, but it is not a prerequisite. We welcome engineers whose coding experience has developed through platform engineering, infrastructure or SRE work.
Architecture, administration and product configuration alone are not sufficient. We want to understand what you personally implemented, tested, automated and supported in production.
We’re interested in what you have personally built and automated: how you provisioned it, tested changes, delivered it safely and enabled other teams to use it without depending on manual intervention. Identity and access is the domain you will work in; specialist experience in that domain is particularly welcome.
This is an opportunity to shape a critical platform capability, with substantial technical ownership and impact across our engineering organisation.
The job
We are hiring two Principal Platform Engineers to help unify authentication and authorisation across our next-generation enterprise software platform.
We are consolidating a fragmented authorisation landscape into one model across three hosting environments: our cloud-native platform, our legacy hosting platform and our lifecycle cloud. It must be correct, fast and reliable in distributed, multi-tenant environments.
Our current stack includes SpiceDB backed by PostgreSQL for authorisation, and Curity for authentication, with Keycloak estates migrating onto it. These describe the systems you will work on; prior experience with every product is not required.
You will design and build platform services, APIs and automation, own them in production, and establish patterns that product engineering teams can adopt confidently. A central part of the role is making secure authentication and authorisation available through documented, automated, self-service workflows.
This is a hands-on role. You will write and review infrastructure and automation code, build platform integrations, and contribute to tooling and services, including those written in Go.
What we need to see
Platform engineering and automation
• Software platforms or shared services you have built and operated for application engineering teams.
• Infrastructure code, automation, delivery pipelines, integrations or platform tooling you have personally built and maintained.
• Automation covering provisioning, configuration, deployment, upgrades and recovery, managed through version control and repeatable delivery pipelines.
• Self-service capabilities that reduce manual intervention and enable developers to work independently.
• Experience deploying and operating containerised application services on Kubernetes in a software delivery environment.
Authorisation
• Practical understanding of access control within applications and APIs, including role-based, attribute-based and relationship-based models.
• Experience implementing permission checks or designing permission models, with an understanding of tenant isolation and security boundaries.
• The ability to reason about correctness, latency, consistency and the traceability of authorisation decisions.
• Familiarity with fine-grained authorisation engines or policy-as-code approaches is valuable.
Authentication
• Practical understanding of authentication for software applications and services, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and token lifecycle management.
• Experience implementing or extending authentication flows in software, with an understanding of validation, trust boundaries and failure modes.
• Understanding of enterprise federation, SSO and external identity-provider integration in a customer-facing platform.
• Deeper experience engineering and operating authentication infrastructure at scale is particularly welcome.
Production ownership
• Experience with cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, containers, GitOps and Infrastructure as Code.
• An approach to reliability that includes observability, performance testing, safe rollouts, rollback, backup and recovery.
• Examples of diagnosing production failures and using code or automation to prevent recurrence.
• Sound engineering judgement across distributed systems, relational data and event-driven services.
How we work
You will remain close to the code while helping other engineers make good architectural decisions. We value clear technical reasoning, constructive challenge and ownership from design through production.
We are interested in how AI-assisted engineering fits into your work: what you delegate, how you review and test the results, and how you remain accountable for the software you ship.

Qualifications
Must have — platform engineering
• Substantial hands-on experience building and operating platforms or shared infrastructure that support software engineering teams.
• Strong coding and scripting skills applied to infrastructure, automation, deployment tooling or integrations. You should be comfortable maintaining code, reviewing changes and using automated tests.
• Experience automating provisioning, configuration, deployment and operational tasks through version-controlled, repeatable workflows.
• Production experience with Kubernetes and containers in an environment delivering and operating software applications.
• Practical experience with a major public cloud platform, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD and GitOps.
• Experience building reusable platform capabilities or self-service workflows that reduce manual work for engineering teams.
• Sound understanding of APIs, networking, data stores and distributed-system behaviour, with the ability to troubleshoot production issues.
• Evidence of technical leadership through design decisions, code reviews, engineering standards and support for other engineers.
Experience developing application or backend services is a strong advantage, but is not required. Your coding experience may come primarily from infrastructure and platform engineering. You should be willing to work with our Go-based tooling and services and develop your capabilities where needed.

Full-time
We need every soldier and officer to be fit and well, so that we have an active, capable Army. That means protecting our troops’ health and wellbeing, wherever they are in the world. As an Environmental Health Technician, you advise commanders on environmental health, occupational hygiene, preventing disease and environmental protection. Whenever troops are deployed, you go out beforehand on reconnaissance missions to check out the location and risks. Then you’ll begin practical training at the Defence School of Healthcare Education. At the same time, you’ll do a BSc (Hons) degree in Environmental Health from Leeds Beckett University. You will gain a NEBOSH General Certificate in Occupational Health and a BPCA Certificate in Pest Control over three years.

-           Have the continuous access promotional opportunity and to continually progress your career

About This Job
About the Child You’ll Support
You will be supporting a bright, affectionate 8‑year‑old who lives at home with their mum, dad, twin sister, and baby brother. The family home has CCTV and sensors to help keep her safe, including CCTV in her bedroom.
She has a life‑limiting genetic condition called Late Infantile Metachromatic Leukodystrophy, which affects her brain and nervous system. Over time, her motor skills have reduced, and she now requires full support with daily activities.
She also experiences:
• Mild global developmental delay
• Severe motor impairment
• Constipation
• A sleep disorder
Every Wednesday afternoon, she attends hospital with her mum for a new drug trial, receiving IV treatment with medication shipped specially from abroad.
Daily Care & Support
Chest physiotherapy is an essential part of her routine, completed daily when she is well. She also uses a cough assist machine during morning and evening physio — only her parents operate this. During the day, she may require oral or nasopharyngeal suctioning if she cannot clear secretions independently.
She is nil by mouth and receives all nutrition and medication through a PEG tube. This also supports her communication, and she may need extra time to express herself.
She still attends school, which she loves. You will travel with her and her mum in the family car in the morning and she returns home on the school minibus. She enjoys chatting about what she sees and staying engaged during journeys.
Her Personality & Interests
She loves:
• Being read to
• Spending time with people
• Playing with her special box of toys
• Gentle interaction
• Most of all — cuddles
If she would like a cuddle, you can safely hoist her to the floor and position her comfortably between your legs. She enjoys cartoons, though screen time is limited, so please check with her parents.
She adores spending time with her sister but also appreciates quiet moments. Her mum will guide you on activities and how best to keep her engaged throughout the day.
Her parents are warm, supportive, and always available to help you.

• Reliability and punctuality
• Excellent communication skills
• Patience, kindness, and a calm nature
• The ability to respond appropriately and professionally in all situations
• A commitment to promoting dignity, respect, and choice
• Observational skills and willingness to deeply understand her needs
• A genuine desire to bring joy, reassurance, and comfort into her day

She responds best to individuals who are:
• Calm
• Gentle
• Kind
• Compassionate
• Patient
• Non‑judgemental
She needs someone who can be both her friend and her professional carer — someone who brings positivity, keeps her safe, and helps make each day as enjoyable and comforting as possible.
She can’t wait to meet the person who will help brighten her world.

Qualifications

• Complex Care experience in a Paediatric setting

Building Physics is a specialist team that sits within our building engineering business line. Our Building Physics engineers support our building engineering and sustainability teams and carry out independent consultancy for a range of clients.

Due to a fantastic period of growth, we are seeking a Principal Cable System Design Engineer to join our expanding Transmission & Distribution (T&D) team within AECOM. This is a senior role within the business, with responsibility for driving technical excellence, leading complex projects, and supporting strategic client engagement across a broad portfolio of high-voltage infrastructure schemes.
As a Principal Engineer, you will play a critical role in the planning, design, and delivery of cable systems across multiple voltage levels. Our clients include Transmission System Operators, Distribution Network Operators, private developers, and international energy majors across the UK and globally.
You will be a trusted advisor to clients, and contribute to developing our technical standards, innovation strategy, and digital delivery approach within the cable engineering space.
This is a fantastic opportunity to contribute to some of the most exciting infrastructure and energy transition projects in the world including National Grid’s Great Grid Upgrade.
Here’s what you will do:
• Assist with leading the delivery of large-scale HV/EHV cable system projects from concept to completion, ensuring quality, safety, and innovation throughout the lifecycle.
• Develop and oversee HV cable system designs, including routing, burial risk assessments, thermal, electromagnetic, and mechanical performance modelling.
• Provide expert-level input into cable system ratings, installation methodologies, jointing arrangements, cleating design, and system integration in challenging environments.
• Guide and validate complex calculations including ampacity, short circuit forces, EMC, induced voltages, and thermomechanical forces to meet compliance with National Grid TPs, IEC, and CIGRÉ standards.
• Undertake client and stakeholder engagement, providing technical assurance, strategic direction, and value-engineered solutions on high-profile infrastructure programmes.
• Manage coordination between disciplines, including civil, structural, OHL, substation, and marine engineering inputs, to ensure cohesive and integrated design solutions.
• Drive project execution, managing technical risks, interfaces, and quality reviews while supporting procurement, construction, and commissioning phases.
• Conduct 3rd-party inspections, FAT/SAT witnessing and vendor oversight for cable and ancillary equipment.
• Champion mentorship, knowledge-sharing, and technical development within the wider team, supporting capability growth in cable systems engineering.
• Support business development activities, including proposals, bid reviews, and client presentations.
Driving excellence.
At AECOM, we are dedicated to fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration within our Transmission and Distribution team. We believe that technology should empower you so that you can focus on creative problem-solving, successfully manage complexity and deliver exceptional results. By embracing advanced automation tools, we seek imaginative thinkers who are excited about leveraging these tools to drive efficiency and enhance our projects. Join us in shaping the future of infrastructure, where your unique insights and creativity will play a vital role in our success!
Enjoy the Perks.
At AECOM, you'll enjoy a range of core and personalised benefits designed to support your future and well-being, customised to fit your lifestyle. Take advantage of career development opportunities, our flexible hybrid working model to ensure a work-life balance that suits your lifestyle, technical practice networks, AECOM University, and volunteering days.

Qualifications
Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?
Here’s what we’re looking for:
• Demonstrated experience as a technical leader in HV/EHV cable system design.
• Proven track record in design, specification, and installation of complex cable systems including tunnel, urban, and constrained environments.
• In-depth understanding of international and UK-specific standards, particularly National Grid TPs, IEC, and CIGRÉ guidelines.
• Experience working in regulated, quality-assured environments—preferably with National Grid, SSE, EirGrid, or equivalent TSO/DNOs.
• Strong ability to coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams and engage with senior stakeholders across the project lifecycle.
• Excellent communication, client-facing, and team leadership/mentorship skills.
• Commitment to fostering innovation, digital delivery, and sustainability in design.
Desirable Certifications & Qualifications
• Degree-qualified in Electrical Engineering or related field; MSc/MEng advantageous.
• Chartered Engineer (CEng) status or working towards.
• National Grid CDAE certification or similar.
• Experience with cable system software (e.g., CYMCAP, WinCable) and advanced analysis tools.
We celebrate diversity, including neurodiversity, and believe it enriches our team. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and abilities. If you are an applicant with a disability that requires reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us at ReasonableAccommodations@aecom.com. At AECOM, we value everyone's unique contributions and perspectives.
If you meet some of the requirements above or have transferable skills you believe would benefit us, we would be delighted to hear from you!

Interested in the role or curious about life at AECOM? Follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube to explore our AECOM voices, employee stories, latest projects, and much more!

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. As a Principal GCP Data Engineer, you'll be a true subject matter expert in using the data processing and management capabilities of Google Cloud to develop data-driven solutions for our clients.
You will typically lead a team or the solution delivery effort, demonstrating technical excellence through leading by example. You could be providing technical support, leading an engineering team or working across multiple teams as a subject matter expert who is critical to the success of a large programme of work.

• Develop robust data processing jobs using tools such as Google Cloud Dataflow, Dataproc and BigQuery
• Design and deliver automated data pipelines that use orchestration tools such as Cloud Composer
• Design end-to-end solutions and contribute to architecture discussions beyond data processing

• Shape team behaviour for writing specifications and acceptance criteria, estimating stories, sprint planning and documentation.
• Actively define and evolve PA’s data engineering standards and practices, ensuring we maintain a shared, modern and robust approach.
• Lead and influence technical discussions with client stakeholders to achieve the collective buy-in required to be successful
• Coach and mentor team members, regardless of seniority, and work with them to build their expertise and understanding.

Qualifications
To be successful in this role, you will need to have:
• Experience delivering and deploying production-ready data processing solutions using BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow and Dataproc
• Experience developing end-to-end solutions using batch and streaming frameworks such as Apache Spark and Apache Beam.
• Expert understanding of when to use a range of data storage technologies including relational/non-relational, document, row-based/columnar data stores, data warehousing and data lakes.
• Expert understanding of data pipeline patterns and approaches such as event-driven architectures, ETL/ELT, stream processing and data visualisation.
• Experience working with business owners to translate business requirements into technical specifications and solution designs  that satisfies the data requirements of the business.
• Experience working with metadata management products such as Cloud Data Catalog and Collibra and Data Governance tools like Dataplex
• Experience in developing solutions on GCP using cloud-native principles and patterns.
• Experience building data quality alerting and data quarantine solutions to ensure downstream datasets can be trusted.
• Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines using techniques including as git code control/branching, automated tests and automated deployments.
• Comfortable working in an Agile team using Scrum or Kanban methodologies.
In addition to the above, we would be thrilled if you also had:
• Experience of working on migrations of enterprise scale data platforms including Hadoop and traditional data warehouses
• An understanding of machine learning model development lifecycle, feature engineering, training and testing
• Good understanding or hands-on experience of Kafka
• Experience as a DBA or developer on RDBMS such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle or SQL Server
• Experience designing data applications to meet non-functional requirements such as performance and availability
Personal qualities
• You are pragmatic and already understand that writing code is only part of what a data engineer does.
• You can clearly communicate with both clients and peers, describing technical issues and solutions in both written and meeting/workshop contexts.
• You are able to clearly explain technical concepts to non technical audiences at all levels of an organisation.
• You are able to influence and persuade senior and specialist client stakeholders, potentially across multiple organisational boundaries without direct authority.
• You are a confident problem solver and troubleshooter.
• You are confident and generous in sharing your specialist knowledge, ideas and solutions.
• You are constantly learning and able to make others better by consciously teaching and unconsciously inspiring.

You will oversee test planning, execution, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives, while managing testing across multiple teams and vendors. The role also includes ownership of incidents within your technical area, driving root cause analysis, defect leakage measurement, and process improvements. Additionally, you will maintain a test coverage model, ensuring clear traceability, transparency, and reporting of quality metrics aligned to business objectives.
Typical Duties include:
• Own and drive the test strategy and quality governance across the team
• Act as the primary contact for test assurance within the release train.
• Coordinate with feature teams (including third-party testers) on test planning, execution, and defect management.
• Ensure test approaches are risk-based, standards-aligned, and appropriate for the delivery context.
• Monitor test progress, triage defects, and escalate risks and blockers as needed.
• Track and report on key quality metrics (e.g., test coverage, defect leakage, automation adoption).
• Define and maintain a test coverage model for the team, ensuring traceability to business and technical requirements.
• Take ownership of incidents related to testing within the team, ensuring thorough root cause analysis (RCA) is conducted and that corrective actions are implemented to prevent recurrence.
• Identify and implement improvements to testing processes and practices based on incident learnings and delivery retrospectives.
• Work collaboratively with central Automation, Non Functional Test teams to ensure alignment to the programme requirements and to preserve and drive consistent standards
• Validate that Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs) are planned and addressed.
• Lead UAT planning and coordination across releases.
• Support Planning to ensure test effort, dependencies, and resources are visible and accounted for.
• Ensure entry/exit criteria are defined and met at each delivery stage.
• Foster a culture of continuous improvement in testing practices across the team.
• Contribute to the test community of practice and champion quality across the organisation.
• Ensure automation developed by feature teams is integrated into the central framework for reuse.

Qualifications
As the perfect candidate for this role, you will already be an experienced Test Manager with a strong track record of leading test strategy, governance, and delivery within Agile environments. You will be skilled at managing testing across multiple teams, driving quality standards, and partnering with stakeholders to identify, mitigate, and communicate delivery risks. An ISTQB certification, or equivalent testing qualification, is desirable.
We would expect you to have expertise in test planning, defect management, quality metrics, UAT coordination, non-functional testing, and enterprise-scale test automation. Proficiency in tools such as Azure DevOps (ADO), Cypress, Postman, and AccelQ etc would be assumed with a strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and modern testing practices. We also encourage candidates to apply who have experience in either automation testing, performance testing or experience with AI. knowledge of Developing is also a bonus, but equally non essential.
We require a collaborative leader who is passionate about; continuous improvement, promoting a quality-first culture, and mentoring testers to drive best practice, increase automation adoption, and improve overall delivery quality.

Meaningful team mission with huge global reach: You’ll be fighting money laundering, terrorism financing and human exploitation across Wise’s £145B+ annual cross-border volume. You’ll be working with global regulators and law enforcement across 65+ licenses and 160+ countries.
•
Cutting edge tech: You’ll be developing state of the art systems to prevent and detect crime in real time, spanning machine learning, LLMs and anything else your team feels is needed to tackle the problem.
•
Product led company: Wise lives and breathes empowerment. Our growth and progress is all down to autonomous product teams investing in what they believe will get us to our mission. You and the team have full authority to decide and the responsibility to get results.
•
Learn from experienced product leadership: You’ll work directly with product management veterans who will invest in your growth and development. You’ll work with Surbhi and Susana, and learn from Gergő and Nilan.
•
Beloved products: Imagine every time you tell someone you work at Wise being showered with compliments about how much they love the product. Our most recent Net Promoter Score was 65+, and over 70% of new customers come through “word-of-mouth”.
We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Squad to make a meaningful dent in global financial crime.
Wise moves £145B+ annually across borders and customers love us for how easy and how cheap it is. You know who else loves moving money cheaply across borders? Criminals looking to launder proceeds of crime.
This is where you come in. Our vision is clean money without borders. We have made great progress in developing a general crime catching machine learning model, and now we need to dig deeper, and get a whole lot more specific. You’ll dive deep into criminal typologies, become an expert in how international crime takes place, and build advanced systems that catch hyper-targeted, regional, criminal behaviour.
About the team
• The AML Squad works across our offices in London and Tallinn. We are growing the Squad, and adding new teams to make faster progress in our fight against crime.
• The AML Squad owns all anti-money laundering, terrorism financing and human exploitation typologies and risks. This includes customer risk scoring, risk prevention, live risk detection, investigations and reporting to Financial Intelligence Units across the globe.
• You’ll be joining one of the cross-functional product teams in the squad focused on detection.
• We measure success by two metrics: AML Recall and Cost of Suspicious Activity Report (SAR).
• AML Recall measures how much of the crime we actually catch. We want this to be as high as possible, and are rapidly expanding our coverage of hyper specific crime detection in addition to our already strong general model.
• Cost of SAR measures how much it costs us to detect, investigate and report a criminal to the relevant authorities. We want this to be as low as possible, and are investing a lot in high precision automation including some cool stuff with LLMs.
You’ll own the challenge of
• Setting new standards of live detecting hyper specific and regional crime at scale, in a way that satisfies our regulatory obligations globally and works financially for our business.
• Working with regional compliance officers (known in the industry as the second line of defense) to deliver global controls that have a strong reputation with local regulators and law enforcement.
• Working with data scientists, product analysts, product designers, product compliance managers, operations leads and software engineers to ensure the team ship the best possible product.
This role will give you the opportunity to
• Choose your own path to success - you’ll have the freedom to define the vision and the responsibility for making it happen
• Be flexible in how and where you work, we understand everyone needs a little something different so we’ll do our best to make it happen
• Travel to work with our teams in London and Tallinn as well as meet various partners and organisations globally when needed
• Inspire teams with your ideas, knowledge and self-starting attitude

Qualifications
A bit about you:
• You are a seasoned PM who has solved large problems at a scale.
• We are open to both Principal and Senior level candidates.
• At the Principal PM level we expect at least 6 years of direct product management experience, ideally closer to 10. For Senior PMs the range is 4 to 8 years.
• You are customer obsessed. You approach every problem from the eyes of the customer. In Anti-Money Laundering, regulators and law enforcement are our “customers”. You need to demonstrate how you apply your user research and empathy skills to build in a way that will make these customers love Wise.
• You have direct and extensive experience in building machine learning, LLM or other advanced algorithmic or data heavy products. Bonus points if this was in anti-money laundering, fraud, fincrime or trust and safety domains.
• You can use different data points, both qualitative and quantitative, to identify, diagnose and prioritise problems and opportunities to solve them.
• You are able to turn a vision into clear, tangible building blocks of a roadmap and have a clear definition of done.
• You have extensive experience of working in a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, analysts, data scientists and researchers.
• You’re hands on, and you’d do everything needed to make the team and the product successful. You get it done.
• You are self driven, you deal well with ambiguity, and you can pave the way for things that have never been done before.

Additional Information
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders  — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

condenast.wd115.myworkdayjobs.com/condec.description_excerpt:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.
Job Description
Location:
London, GB
Condé Nast is one of the world’s most renowned media companies creating and distributing every type of media today – print, video and film, digital, audio and social.  Our company is home to iconic brands including Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Glamour, AD, Vanity Fair and Wired, among many others. The company's award-winning content reaches 84 million consumers in print, 367 million in digital and 379 million across social platforms, and generates more than 1 billion video views each month. We are seeking a Vice President of Communications to lead our communications in the UK, a market essential to our global brand presence.
Based in London, this person will shape how Condé Nast, its brands and its leaders show up across the British media and cultural landscape. The remit spans the full breadth of the business: from Condé Nast’s commercial strategy and corporate reputation to the journalism, editors, talent and cultural moments behind brands including Vogue, GQ, WIRED, Condé Nast Traveller, Glamour, Tatler, House & Garden and The World of Interiors.
This is both a U.K. leadership role and a senior position within Condé Nast’s global communications team. The VP will lead the U.K. communications team, advise senior executives and editorial leaders, and work closely with communications colleagues around the world on issues and opportunities that increasingly cross markets.
Condé Nast thrives on collaboration, and our teams come together in the office four days a week (Monday - Thursday).
We value diversity of background, views and cultures. We celebrate people for their personal qualities, skills and contributions, recognising the power our brands have to influence and shape culture.
The leadership role reports to the Global Communications Officer and the position is based in London.
Key Responsibilities
• Own Condé Nast’s communications strategy and reputation in the U.K., with a clear point of view on where the company and its brands should be part of the conversation.
• Lead corporate, business and brand communications across Condé Nast’s U.K. portfolio, spanning commercial priorities, editorial initiatives, talent, launches, partnerships and major cultural moments.
• Lead and develop the U.K. communications team, setting priorities and creating ambitious, high-quality work across a complex portfolio of brands.
• Serve as a senior member of the global communications team, working closely with the Chief Communications Officer and senior communications leadership on company-wide priorities and issues.
• Advise and position senior U.K. and European leaders on media strategy, messaging, speaking opportunities and reputation.
• Advise editorial leaders how to achieve maximum impact and external awareness for their work. Implement plans to do so.
• Build communications around Condé Nast’s journalism and editorial leadership, identifying where our editors, writers and creative talent can shape conversations beyond our own platforms.
• Bring a deep understanding of the British news, business, media, technology and cultural landscape, spotting opportunities early and knowing when Condé Nast should lead a conversation, join one or stay out of it.
• Maintain strong relationships with influential journalists and editors across national, business, trade, broadcast and cultural media.
• Lead communications through sensitive and high-profile issues, providing clear counsel to senior leaders and coordinating responses across functions and markets.
• Work closely with editorial, commercial, consumer marketing, people and other teams to turn business priorities into compelling external narratives.
• Write and oversee sharp, high-quality communications materials, from messaging and executive briefs to announcements, Q&As and statements.
• Help shape how Condé Nast communicates globally, bringing ideas, judgment and lessons from the U.K. market to the wider communications organisation.
What we’re looking for
• A senior communications leader with significant experience in media, publishing, entertainment or another business where brands, talent, culture and corporate reputation intersect.
• A problem-solver that tries new approaches and unexpected ideas.
• Deep knowledge of the U.K. media landscape and strong, current relationships with the journalists and editors who shape business, media and cultural conversations.
• The ability to move comfortably between corporate reputation and brand storytelling, and to understand how the two reinforce each other.
• Excellent news judgment and a strong instinct for what makes a story, rather than simply what makes an announcement.
• A sophisticated understanding of how media consumption, platforms and influence are changing, particularly in the U.K., and what that means for modern communications.
• A track record of advising senior executives and high-profile talent, including in complex or sensitive situations.
• Significant crisis and issues-management experience, with the judgment to operate calmly and decisively when the stakes are high.
• Experience leading and developing high-performing communications teams.
• The ability to operate effectively across a global organization, building strong relationships across markets, brands and functions.
• Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to make complicated ideas clear, concise and compelling.
• Approximately 12+ years of relevant communications experience. We are more interested in the depth and quality of that experience than where you acquired it.
• Demonstrated ability to lead teams through uncertainty and change, providing a steady and confident hand during business transformation.
• Proven experience in managing enterprise-level accountability, ensuring communications strategy is seamlessly aligned with broader business objectives and cultural values.
What benefits do we offer?
• 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays) and extra days of annual leave if you move house or want to volunteer.
• You’ll have access to a competitive pension scheme, Bupa Private Healthcare, Season ticket loans…

SMT is a leading full-service distribution company specializing in machinery and trucks. Our focus is on providing equipment for the construction, material handling, recycling, and transport industry. We are active in large parts of Africa, Belgium & Luxembourg, Great Britain, the Netherlands, and in US.
Job Title: Field Service Engineer
Location: Field-Based – Looking for two FSE's, Open to all applicants within Central Scotland
Contract: Full Time, Permanent
About the Role
We are looking for two Field Service Engineer's to join our team, supporting areas across Central Scotland.
The focus of this role is to deliver a first-class service to both internal and external customers while maintaining and repairing Volvo Construction Equipment and associated machinery. You'll be responsible for identifying customer needs, maximising machine uptime and promoting SMT GB's aftermarket products and services where appropriate.
What You'll Be Doing
• Service, maintain and repair Volvo Construction Equipment and associated machinery.
• Diagnose and resolve mechanical, hydraulic and electrical faults using technical expertise and diagnostic equipment.
• Identify additional service and repair opportunities and discuss these with customers and internal teams.
• Carry out all work in line with quotations and time guides, highlighting where additional work may be required.
• Install software updates and system enhancements when released.
• Complete electronic job cards, reports and timesheets accurately and in real time.
• Order and manage parts required for repairs and return parts promptly upon job completion.
• Support call-out and overtime requirements where required.
• Attend product and systems training to maintain technical competence and product knowledge.
• Ensure all work is completed safely and in accordance with company and manufacturer standards.
About You
To be successful in this role, you'll bring strong technical capability, a proactive attitude and a customer-focused approach. You'll be someone who takes pride in delivering high-quality work, enjoys problem-solving and can work independently while representing SMT GB professionally on customer sites.
You will have:
• A formal engineering qualification in Plant Maintenance, Agricultural Engineering, HGV Mechanics or a related discipline (NVQ Level 3, City & Guilds or equivalent).
• Proven experience repairing and maintaining heavy construction plant, agricultural machinery, HGVs or similar equipment.
• Strong diagnostic and fault-finding skills across diesel engines, transmissions, drivetrains, hydraulics and electrical systems.
• The ability to read and interpret technical manuals, wiring diagrams and service information.
• Experience using diagnostic tools and electronic service systems.
• Excellent problem-solving abilities and a methodical approach to fault diagnosis.
• Good communication skills and the ability to build positive relationships with customers and colleagues.
• Strong IT skills and confidence using digital reporting systems and mobile technology.
• A commercially aware mindset with a focus on delivering excellent customer service and identifying opportunities to support customers further.
• The ability to manage your own workload effectively, prioritising jobs and responding to changing customer requirements.
• A commitment to maintaining high standards of health, safety and environmental compliance.
• High levels of attention to detail and a professional approach to work.
• A positive, flexible attitude and willingness to participate in overtime and call-out activities when required.
• A full UK driving licence.
Desirable
• Welding and fabrication experience.
• Previous experience working with Volvo Construction Equipment or similar heavy plant machinery.
• Experience working in a field-based service environment.
• Familiarity with telematics systems and modern machine technology.
• Relevant health and safety qualifications such as IOSH Working Safely.
• LGV/HGV, plant operator or lifting-related qualifications.
What We Offer
Alongside a competitive salary and company van, you'll benefit from:
• Health Cash Plan, 24/7 GP access and physiotherapy support.
• Enhanced sick pay, maternity, paternity and adoption leave.
• Pension with up to 5% employer contributions.
• Cycle to Work scheme and salary sacrifice car leasing options.
• Employee discounts platform.
• Paid volunteering day, refer-a-friend bonus and long service awards.
• Access to employee-led initiatives, recognition programmes and wellbeing support.
Apply Now
We are interviewing on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close this vacancy once a suitable candidate has been identified. Early applications are encouraged.
Our values
Our way of working as a professional community, can be best described as Caring, Daring and Sharing. Caring because we are service-minded, and we always like to go the extra mile for our customers and give our people the attention and care they deserve. Daring because we are innovative in our business, constantly looking for smart improvement. And finally Sharing because we realize we’re doing this together; with our clients, with a great team of skilled specialists, excellent manufacturers and reliable suppliers. These values create an engaging environment for passionate people who like to work in a place with purpose.

These parties are not permitted to submit CVs or applications to SMT or its employees in any form, including, but not limited to, email, social media or online platforms, whether directly or indirectly.

About the Hiring Team
Tencent Overseas IT has the mission to empower Tencent’s rapid global growth with future ready, global IT platforms, applications and services. We are chartered to lead the Overseas IT strategy, architecture, roadmap and execution. Satisfying our internal/external customers and becoming a world class global IT team are our top aspirations.
What the Role Entails
We are looking for a lead game development expert with deep AAA production experience to strengthen co-development and technical partnership between Tencent and its overseas investment and partner studios.
The successful candidate will bring a strong technical art and animation background, with a particular focus on asset production and animation workflows. Instead of covering the full breadth of art disciplines, this role concentrates on AI-enabled asset creation, asset performance optimisation, asset visual fidelity and on the animation side skeleton design, rigging and physics-based animation.
•
Participate in co-development projects between Tencent and its overseas investment and partner studios, providing senior expertise in AI-enabled asset production, asset performance optimisation, asset visual quality, skeleton design, rigging and physics-based animation.
•
Make AI-driven asset and animation improvement a central pillar of technical collaboration. Identify concrete opportunities across the full asset lifecycle (modelling, texturing, materials, LODs, performance profiling) and animation disciplines (skeleton generation, skinning, control rigs, cloth, hair, rigid-body dynamics and ragdoll setups).
•
Lead or contribute to proof-of-concept projects that integrate AI tools with existing asset authoring tools, animation rigging environments, physics engines, and Unreal Engine or equivalent game engines.
•
Evaluate the suitability, feasibility and expected value of AI solutions for asset and animation challenges. Define measurable metrics covering asset creation time, memory/performance budgets, visual fidelity, rigging speed, animation quality, physics stability and overall pipeline scalability.
•
Work closely with Art Directors, Technical Artists, Animators, Riggers, Character Artists, Environment Artists, Engineers, Producers and AI specialists to translate creative and production requirements into practical, measurable solutions focused on assets and animation.
•
Drive the transition of successful AI experiments into daily production workflows. Collect user feedback, refine asset and animation pipelines, and document repeatable implementation approaches for asset generation, optimisation, rigging automation and physics setup.
•
Establish human-review and quality-control mechanisms for AI-assisted asset and animation workflows, ensuring visual consistency, animation fidelity, physical plausibility, performance targets and intellectual property/data security are respected.
•
Lead technical investigations and solution designs for complex asset production challenges (e.g., automated LOD generation, material and texture optimisation, shader performance) and animation challenges (e.g., auto-rigging, physics-aware motion, real-time cloth simulation).
•
Bridge overseas studio requirements with Tencent’s internal AI capabilities, asset platforms, animation technology stacks and subject-matter experts.
•
